title: Text: DET Rick Anderson ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Give me a ring whenever you have a few minutes, want to run a couple things by you after listening to Al talk today, off record
I gotta do a roster projection for taxi squad. Off-record, not for use but I have 11 guys ... Mize, Manning, Skubal (L), Faedo, Ramirez (L), Chiang, Agrazal, Santiago (L), Moreno, Pinto
No Moreno, Santiago and Pinto
How many P?
15 on the taxi, 25 on the roster
15??? on the taxi
Yes
Dang. I thought it was 20 man total.
I had 11 P on here
30 pitchers, 30 position players
I’m glad I texted you. I gotta do more research. I thought it was the 40-man roster plus a 20-man taxi squad, however many pitchers/players
No 30 man roster for the first 15 days, 28 for another 15 then 26 for the last
Ok. That’s the active roster that you guys play with
Then there’s the 40-man
Then the rest are on the taxi squad, 20 guys
We will start off with 30 players on our roster and have 30 on the taxi squad
Yep. Then 32 two weeks later and 34 after that
No, 28 then 26
Lol... we could’ve figured this out on the phone in 30 sec. Roster starts at 30, taxi 30
Then roster goes to 28, so wouldn’t Taxi go to 32
Yes
Then 26 and 34?
Yes and yes, lol
Yep. We were talking about the same thing. K
Yes, both sides add up to 60 players.
So it’s split 30 pitchers, position players to start.
This has become a math problem, which I suck at
25 total on the 60-man?
15 on the taxi end of it (30 players)
25 total pitchers on 60-man, 15 pitchers on taxi, which totals 30 players
